repository_inspection.extension_strategy: new automation/core/studio-v2 module plus versioned schemas; no legacy file rewritten

AUT-014.inspection_note: Repository deployment metadata contains historical top-level and later nested runtime versions/node counts; live project verification was unavailable and is required before any future mutation.

live_n8n_inspection.reason: No n8n connector or signed-in project tab was exposed in this session.
live_n8n_inspection.scope_effect: Architecture completed from project-scoped deployment records; no runtime claim or mutation made.

architecture_decisions.object_persistence: Hybrid additive model: versioned creative envelopes in studio_objects; continuity/jobs/evaluations/cost/QC receive dedicated operational tables.
architecture_decisions.continuity: Immutable snapshots with parent hashes and compare-and-swap series head; hard failures block before cost.
architecture_decisions.routing: Provider-neutral hard gates plus deterministic versioned scoring; router performs zero provider mutations.
architecture_decisions.generation: One active attempt per job; automatic paid retries zero; submitted ambiguity becomes outcome_unknown.
architecture_decisions.cost: Append-only integer-minor-unit ledger with reservation before claim and actual settlement after provider evidence.
architecture_decisions.integration: Only accepted assembled episode masters cross into asset_registry/content_outputs and then existing AUT-015/AUT-014 gates.
architecture_decisions.workflow_shape: Ten independently testable future modules; no monolithic n8n workflow.
